format: one row per ligament strand; positions in the body frame of 'body' (chest_r: right side, mirrored to the left)
description: Shoulder-girdle ligaments as passive spatial tendons (scripts/fit_ligaments.py; proposal MyoHub/myo_sim#142). Force law: quadratic toe of Blankevoort 1991, F = k e^2 / (2 e_t), tension only; no damping.
modulus_note: 10 MPa: apparent modulus of the coracoclavicular ligaments, k L / A from Costic et al. 2003 (conoid 11.4, trapezoid 7.7 MPa)
